Drawing archive.

Three concept projects. Thirty A3 vector sheets. Plans, elevations, sections, 1:5 junction studies and exploded isometric assemblies. Proposed dimensions; not construction documentation.

Print on A3 landscape at 100% / actual size. Disable browser headers and footers. On each 1:5 detail, the 500 mm scale bar must measure 100 mm on paper.
